title: Open-set module cohomology and canonical restriction
statement: Let $X$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ and an $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$, define the additive-group-valued sections functor by $\Gamma_U(F)=F(U)$. Define $H^p(U,F|_U)=R^p\Gamma_U(F)$ for $p\in\mathbb N$, using the injective $\mathcal O_X$-module resolutions of [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology]. For an inclusion $V\subseteq U$, define its canonical restriction $H^p(U,F|_U)\to H^p(V,F|_V)$ as the right derived natural transformation of sectionwise restriction $\Gamma_U\to\Gamma_V$. These are functors in $F$.
